title: System Settings
subtitle: Platform-level configuration — admin access only.
integrationCredentialsHint: Register an OAuth application on each provider's developer portal to obtain these credentials.
stravaHint: Create an app at developers.strava.com to get your Client ID and Secret.
garminHint: Register an app at developer.garmin.com to get your Consumer Key and Secret.
webhookSecretHint: Required once credentials are set, otherwise every incoming webhook is rejected and imports stop silently. Use a long random value, then register the provider's callback URL as https://<your-host>/api/webhooks/<provider>?secret=<the value>.
aiProviderHint: Configure the AI model used to generate activity analysis reports.
